```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
publication <- read_publication("out/release/elo")
```

Independent ratings of men's international teams, with the match results,
methods, and history available to inspect.

::: {.publication-date}
**Elo ratings through `r publication$manifest$analysis$as_of`.**
Updated weekly, with monthly history available to download.
:::

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat('<div class="format-grid">\n')
for (format in c("Test", "ODI", "T20I")) {
  table <- head(site_ratings(publication, format), 5)
  cat('<section class="format-card">\n')
  cat(sprintf('<h2><a href="docs/%s.html">%s</a></h2>\n', tolower(format), format))
  cat(knitr::kable(table[c("Rank", "Team", "Elo")], format = "html", escape = TRUE))
  cat(sprintf('<p><a href="docs/%s.html">All ratings and histories →</a></p>\n', tolower(format)))
  cat('</section>\n')
}
cat('</div>\n')
```

## Read the ratings

A higher Elo rating means a stronger team under this model. Results update each
format separately; rating points should not be compared across formats.

The format pages show recent trajectories, full histories by team, and all
currently active teams. Teams with fewer than
`r publication$manifest$analysis$specification$provisional_matches` rated matches are marked
provisional. These are baseline Elo estimates, without uncertainty intervals
or venue adjustments.

[How the ratings work](docs/methods.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[Download the data](docs/data.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Beyond Elo

GAM, Stan, and Glicko-2 have been fitted and evaluated in a Test-match experiment.
See [Research](docs/research.qmd) for their ratings, charts, and forecast scores.
These experimental results are separate from the weekly Elo publication.
